_comment: Single source of truth for site constants. Read by every tools/*.py script and embedded into the page as SITE (see tools/build.py). Change values here, never hard-code them elsewhere.
name: Zrak na raskrižju

station.name: ZAGREB-1
station.address: NW corner of Ulica grada Vukovara x Miramarska cesta, east end of Park Drage Galića

background.name: ZAGREB-4
background.note: Default background for NOx, NO2, O3, PM10, PM2.5 (docs/research/critic.md §1.2). Mirogojska (280) is NOT used by default.

frame._comment: Local metric frame used by EVERY layer: x = (lon - lon0) * kx (east), z = -(lat - lat0) * ky (south), y = up, metres above local ground. True north is -z. kx, ky = WGS84/GRS80 metres per degree of longitude/latitude at lat0 (N·cosφ·π/180, M·π/180), so the frame is isometric to 0.01 % within ±750 m (docs/02-geometry.md §2.3).

iszz.time_semantics: epoch ms UTC marking the END of the averaging hour

openmeteo.note: Instantaneous values: average t-1 and t (vector-average the wind) to match ISZZ hour-ending means.
